# braintrust_users (Data Source)

Use this data source to list Braintrust users, optionally filtered by email address or ID. Unlike `braintrust_user`, emails or IDs that don't match a user are omitted from `users` rather than failing, so it can be used to find which of a set of emails have Braintrust accounts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every user in the organization.
data "braintrust_users" "all" {}

# Look up several users at once. Emails without a Braintrust account are
# omitted from `users` instead of failing.
data "braintrust_users" "team" {
  emails = ["alice@example.com", "bob@example.com", "carol@example.com"]
}

locals {
  team_user_ids = { for u in data.braintrust_users.team.users : u.email => u.id }
}

resource "braintrust_group" "engineering" {
  name         = "Engineering"
  member_users = values(local.team_user_ids)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `emails` (Set of String) Only return users with these email addresses. If unset, users are not filtered by email.
- `ids` (Set of String) Only return users with these IDs (UUIDs). If unset, users are not filtered by ID.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Matching users, sorted by email. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) URL of the user's avatar image.
- `created` (String) Date of user creation.
- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `family_name` (String) Family (last) name of the user.
- `given_name` (String) Given (first) name of the user.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the user (UUID).
